title: A create whose answer was lost, or in flight at a kill, is settled from the engine write log and never written twice
steps: Apply a create whose answer the live engine drops after writing; apply the same push again; Undo it.
Kill the writer while a create is in flight; run the writer settle op; Undo the push.
Two lost creates of one kind, one never made.
expect: The create is written under the live number apply.list names, the id map learns it, no second content.update, Undo trashes it.
settle journals it written; a second settle finds nothing; Undo takes it back; one content.update in all.
The made one is paired by its fields; the other is NOT_WRITTEN.

tests: a lost create answer is settled by the engine
two lost creates of one kind are told apart by their fields
a worker killed after create cannot resend that create
a create in flight when the job was killed is settled before the next sync
